item.title: 👊 Rough welcome for Ukrainian saboteurs The Vostok Group's drones hit an AFU sabotage and reconnaissance group
item.description: 👊 Rough welcome for Ukrainian saboteurs 🎮 The Vostok Group's drones hit an AFU sabotage and reconnaissance group in Dnepropetrovsk region. 🎯 The militants tried to covertly approach Russian positions through forest belts, but were detected from the air. In the hope to save their life, the nationalists decided to disperse and take shelter, but our 'birds' turned out to be faster. ✅ The sabotage and reconnaissance group was neutralised. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📆 Faithful to his duty and his people to the very end On 28 October 2026, in the course of engineering reconnaissance and road demining to ensure safety of the routes of the humani
item.description: Faithful to his duty and his people to the very end 📆 On 28 October 2026, in the course of engineering reconnaissance and road demining to ensure safety of the routes of the humanitarian convoy to Aleshki (Kherson region), EOD serviceman , sergeant of the 98th Guards Airborne Division, Andrei Vedernikov, lost his life. ▫️ The Russian serviceman was mortally wounded in an explosion while attempting to defuse an explosive device planted by a Ukrainian drone . The device was equipped with a Doppler sensor that detonated upon proximity. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

📍
During the week, units of the Tsentr Group of Forces took advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade, an assault brigade, an airborne brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, three marine brigades, and five national guard brigades.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 2,400 troops, 38 armoured fighting vehicles, 67 motor vehicles, five field artillery guns, and 13 electronic warfare stations.
🚩
Last week, units of the Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance to depths of the enemy's defence and, as a result of resolute actions,
liberated the village of Obshcheye in Zaporozhye region.
💥
Russian troops
inflicted damage on
manpower and hardware of two assault brigades, three air assault brigades, three assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade.
▪️
In total, more than 1,390 troops, 12 armoured fighting vehicles, 42 motor vehicles, three field artillery guns, and three electronic and counter-fire stations were neutralised in the of the Vostok Group's area of responsibility.
📍
Over the past week, units of the Dnepr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade, an assault regiment of the AFU, and a territorial defence brigade.
▪️
Up to 205 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 65 motor vehicles, and 10 electronic warfare and counter-fire stations were neutralised.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
six guided aerial bombs, three air-to-surface cruise missiles, including two UK-made Storm Shadow missiles, and one French-made SCALP missile, six Neptune long-range cruise missiles, as well as 6,900 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out a massive strike by ground-based high-precision weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles against enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry and energy facilities that support its operation, as well as port infrastructure facilities and ships used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: 📍 in Kiev and Kiev region: ▫️ the missile unit and component plant (JSC Kiev Radio Plant, LLC Trimen-Ukraine), which produces components for reconnaissance and attack UAVs, including long-range ones; ▫️ the unmanned aerial vehicle assembly and storage workshop (PJSC Fanplit), which produces and stores FP-1, FP-2 long- and medium-range UAVs of the Fire Point company; ▫️ the PS-330 Novokievskaya power substation in the settlement of Khotov, ensuring the operation of enterprises of the Ukrainian defence industry in Kiev; 📍 in Dnepropetrovsk region: ▫️ the PS-330 Svetloye power substation in the settlement of Svetloye, which ensures the operation of defence industry enterprises in the city of Dnepr; ▫️ in the Black Sea waters, a dry cargo ship delivering military materiel and dual-use cargo for the AFU to the port of Odessa. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
